title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Reduction Earned by Prepaid Technician Hours
content:
## Portfolio accounts Q&A

**What earns the reduction?** A reduction is earned against the price of an additional visit on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record by the prepaid technician hours the owner still holds on a demand service rate program under the Demand Service Rate Programs.

**How much is it?**

| Prepaid technician hours the owner still holds | Reduction earned |
|---|---|
| above the block threshold of 8 hours | the block holder reduction, 60.00 USD |
| at or below the block threshold of 8 hours and above none | the part block reduction, 30.00 USD |
| none at all | no reduction |

**Where does the boundary fall?** At exactly 8 prepaid hours the holding stands at the threshold, not above it, so the part block reduction of 30.00 USD is earned; at 8.5 hours the holding stands above the threshold and the block holder reduction of 60.00 USD is earned; at zero hours no reduction is earned.

**Is the reduction taken per hour?** No. It is the single figure the reading selects, taken off once.

**Which records are read?** The prepaid technician hours standing on the owner's Demand Service Rate Programs holding, not the maintenance agreement's own entitlement.
